title: Realistic rebuild: Pumpkin Moon and Frost Moon bosses (Mourning Wood, Pumpking, Everscream, Santa-NK1)
player_outcome: The moon-event bosses stop looking like primitive assemblies. Mourning Wood is a gnarled haunted tree that stalks on its roots, Pumpking a cloaked jack-o'-lantern lord with scythe hands, Everscream an evil ornamented pine, and Santa-NK1 a festive war tank.
design: New tools/blender/bgen/bosses_moons.py (split into bosses_moons2.py if near 400 lines).
mourning_wood: organic trunk (detail.organic), bark layer, carved glowing face, root legs rigged with a walk clip.
pumpking: a pumpkin head with a carved glowing face and stem crown, a tattered cloak body, and separate 'pumpking_blade' hand models so its hands can later become parts via HandBrain 'swipe'.
everscream: a pine with ornaments, glowing eyes and a maw.
santa_nk1: tank treads, a hull, a santa-faced turret on a rotating turret bone, and a rocket pod.
Switch the assets.json generators, rebuild, and update the boss icons (P4-03 --boss-icons).
Retire festive.py's primitive generators once they are unused.
data_changes: Optional: pumpking parts [pumpking_blade ×2] with the HandBrain swipe style (a data follow-up).
tests: build_all.py --check; AssetCoverage; smoke hardmode/events scripts spawning them stay error-free
verification: tools/blender/preview.py contact sheets; the boss gallery tour (game/Testing/Tours/bosses.cmds) screenshots at medium graphics
risks: Rig clip names must match what NpcRenderer.Motion plays (idle/move/attack). Reuse bosses_pre2.clips naming.
